تستحيوا (form X)
# تَسْتَحْيُوا (tastaḥyū) /tas.taħ.juː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
# تُسْتَحْيَوْا (tustaḥyaw) /tus.taħ.jaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
